001package com.streamconverter.web;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004import java.io.InputStream;
005import java.util.Locale;
006import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
007import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
008import org.slf4j.Logger;
009import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
010import org.springframework.core.io.buffer.DataBuffer;
011import org.springframework.core.io.buffer.DefaultDataBufferFactory;
012import org.springframework.core.io.buffer.DataBufferUtils;
013import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
014import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
015import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
016import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
017
018import com.streamconverter.StreamConverter;
019import com.streamconverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
020import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
021import com.streamconverter.command.impl.csv.CsvNavigateCommand;
022import com.streamconverter.command.impl.json.JsonNavigateCommand;
023import com.streamconverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
024import com.streamconverter.path.CSVPath;
025import com.streamconverter.path.TreePath;
026
027import reactor.core.publisher.Flux;
028import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
029
030/**
031 * Web API controller for StreamConverter processing.
032 *
033 * <p>Provides REST endpoints to process data streams using existing StreamConverter functionality.
034 */
035@RestController
036@RequestMapping("/api/v1/stream")
037public class StreamProcessingController {
038
039  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(StreamProcessingController.class);
040
041  private static final int MAX_PIPELINE_CONFIG_LENGTH = 1000;
042  private static final int MAX_PIPELINE_COMMANDS = 10;
043  private static final int MAX_PARAMETER_LENGTH = 500;
044
045  /**
046   * Process data stream with CSV extraction.
047   *
048   * @param inputData binary input data
049   * @param columnName CSV column name to extract
050   * @return processed data as binary stream
051   */
052  @PostMapping(
053      value = "/csv/extract",
054      consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE,
055      produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE)
056  public Mono<ResponseEntity<Flux<DataBuffer>>> processCsvExtraction(
057      @RequestBody Flux<DataBuffer> inputData, @RequestParam String columnName) {
058
059    logger.info("Processing CSV extraction for column: {}", columnName);
060
061    return Mono
062        .fromCallable(
063            () ->
064                ResponseEntity.ok(
065                    processWithStreamConverter(
066                        inputData,
067                        CsvNavigateCommand.create(
068                            CSVPath.of(columnName), new PassThroughRule()))))
069        .onErrorResume(
070            e -> {
071              logger.error("CSV extraction failed: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
072              return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
073            });
074  }
075
076  /**
077   * Process data stream with JSON path extraction.
078   *
079   * @param inputData binary input data
080   * @param jsonPath JSON path expression
081   * @return processed data as binary stream
082   */
083  @PostMapping(
084      value = "/json/extract",
085      consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE,
086      produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE)
087  public Mono<ResponseEntity<Flux<DataBuffer>>> processJsonExtraction(
088      @RequestBody Flux<DataBuffer> inputData, @RequestParam String jsonPath) {
089
090    logger.info("Processing JSON extraction for path: {}", jsonPath);
091
092    return Mono
093        .fromCallable(
094            () ->
095                ResponseEntity.ok(
096                    processWithStreamConverter(
097                        inputData,
098                        JsonNavigateCommand.create(
099                            TreePath.fromJson(jsonPath), new PassThroughRule()))))
100        .onErrorResume(
101            e -> {
102              logger.error("JSON extraction failed: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
103              return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
104            });
105  }
106
107  /**
108   * Process data stream with custom command pipeline.
109   *
110   * @param inputData binary input data
111   * @param pipelineConfig pipeline configuration header
112   * @return processed data as binary stream
113   */
114  @PostMapping(
115      value = "/process",
116      consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE,
117      produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM_VALUE)
118  public Mono<ResponseEntity<Flux<DataBuffer>>> processWithPipeline(
119      @RequestBody Flux<DataBuffer> inputData,
120      @RequestHeader("X-Pipeline-Config") String pipelineConfig) {
121
122    return Mono
123        .fromCallable(() -> buildPipelineFromConfig(pipelineConfig))
124        .map(
125            commands -> {
126              logger.info("Processing pipeline with {} commands", commands.length);
127              return ResponseEntity.ok(processWithStreamConverter(inputData, commands));
128            })
129        .onErrorResume(
130            IllegalArgumentException.class,
131            e -> {
132              logger.warn("Invalid pipeline config: {}", e.getMessage());
133              return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST).build());
134            })
135        .onErrorResume(
136            e -> {
137              logger.error("Pipeline processing failed: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
138              return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
139            });
140  }
141
142  /**
143   * Health check endpoint.
144   *
145   * @return simple health status
146   */
147  @GetMapping("/health")
148  public Mono<ResponseEntity<String>> health() {
149    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.ok("StreamConverter Web API is running"));
150  }
151
152  /**
153   * Processes data using StreamConverter with given commands in a streaming fashion.
154   *
155   * @param inputData reactive stream of input data buffers
156   * @param commands stream commands to execute
157   * @return processed output as Flux of DataBuffer
158   */
159  private Flux<DataBuffer> processWithStreamConverter(
160      Flux<DataBuffer> inputData, IStreamCommand... commands) {
161    DefaultDataBufferFactory bufferFactory = new DefaultDataBufferFactory();
162    ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
163    return Flux
164        .from(
165            DataBufferUtils.outputStreamPublisher(
166                outputStream -> {
167                  try (InputStream inputStream =
168                      DataBufferUtils.subscriberInputStream(inputData, 4096)) {
169                    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(commands);
170                    converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
171                  } catch (IOException e) {
172                    throw new RuntimeException("Stream processing failed", e);
173                  }
174                },
175                bufferFactory,
176                executor))
177        .doFinally(signalType -> executor.shutdown());
178  }
179
180  /**
181   * Builds a pipeline from configuration string.
182   *
183   * @param config pipeline configuration (e.g., "csv:name,json:$.result,process:validator")
184   * @return array of stream commands
185   * @throws IllegalArgumentException config が null/空/長すぎる、またはコマンド数・パラメータが不正な場合
186   */
187  private IStreamCommand[] buildPipelineFromConfig(String config) {
188    if (config == null || config.isBlank()) {
189      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Pipeline config must not be null or blank");
190    }
191    if (config.length() > MAX_PIPELINE_CONFIG_LENGTH) {
192      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
193          "Pipeline config exceeds maximum length of " + MAX_PIPELINE_CONFIG_LENGTH);
194    }
195
196    String[] commandConfigs = config.split(",", -1);
197    if (commandConfigs.length > MAX_PIPELINE_COMMANDS) {
198      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
199          "Pipeline config exceeds maximum command count of " + MAX_PIPELINE_COMMANDS);
200    }
201
202    IStreamCommand[] commands = new IStreamCommand[commandConfigs.length];
203
204    for (int i = 0; i < commandConfigs.length; i++) {
205      String[] parts = commandConfigs[i].split(":", 2);
206      String commandType = parts[0].trim();
207      if (commandType.isEmpty()) {
208        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Command type must not be empty at index " + i);
209      }
210      String parameter = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1].trim() : "";
211      if (parameter.length() > MAX_PARAMETER_LENGTH) {
212        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
213            "Parameter exceeds maximum length of " + MAX_PARAMETER_LENGTH + " at index " + i);
214      }
215
216      commands[i] =
217          switch (commandType.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
218            case "csv" -> {
219              if (parameter.isEmpty()) {
220                throw new IllegalArgumentException("csv command requires a column name at index " + i);
221              }
222              yield CsvNavigateCommand.create(CSVPath.of(parameter), new PassThroughRule());
223            }
224            case "json" -> {
225              if (parameter.isEmpty()) {
226                throw new IllegalArgumentException("json command requires a path at index " + i);
227              }
228              yield JsonNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromJson(parameter), new PassThroughRule());
229            }
230            case "process" -> new AbstractStreamCommand() {
231              @Override
232              public void execute(InputStream in, java.io.OutputStream out) throws IOException {
233                in.transferTo(out);
234              }
235
236              @Override
237              public String commandName() {
238                return "process";
239              }
240            };
241            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown command type: " + commandType);
242          };
243    }
244
245    logger.info("Built pipeline with {} commands", commands.length);
246    return commands;
247  }
248}
